select:
WITH MY_KEY_IDS AS ( SELECT HAK.KEY_NAME, HAKA.AUTH_CD, HAKA.PRJ_ID, HAK.KEY_ID, HAKA.REG_USER_ID FROM HCP_API_KEY HAK JOIN HCP_API_KEY_AUTH HAKA ON HAK.KEY_ID = HAKA.KEY_ID JOIN TABLE(HCP_GET_AUTH_PRJ(#{sysEmpNo})) PRJ ON HAKA.PRJ_ID = PRJ.PRJ_ID WHERE HAKA.AUTH_CD = 'PSN' AND HAKA.REG_USER_ID = #{sysEmpNo} ),
TARGET_IDS AS ( SELECT HAS.SVC_ID, MKI.KEY_ID, MKI.KEY_NAME, MKI.PRJ_ID, MKI.REG_USER_ID AS SYS_EMP_NO FROM ( SELECT * FROM HCP_API_SVC WHERE SVC_ENV = UPPER('${hcp.application.env}') ) HAS JOIN ( SELECT HAB.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD FROM HCP_API_BASE HAB JOIN HCP_API_PUB P ON HAB.API_ID = P.API_ID JOIN HCP_API_SUB SUB ON SUB.PUB_ID = P.PUB_ID WHERE SUB.SUB_STAT_CD IN ('NOR', 'APR') GROUP BY HAB.SVC_ID, SUB.KEY_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD ) Z ON HAS.SVC_ID = Z.SVC_ID JOIN MY_KEY_IDS MKI ON MKI.KEY_ID = Z.KEY_ID WHERE HAS.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND ( HAS.DEL_YN = 'N' OR (HAS.DEL_YN = 'Y' AND HAS.RES_DTTM >= SYSDATE) ) )
SELECT API.API_ID, API.SVC_ID, PUB.PUB_ID, SUB.SUB_STAT_CD AS BEFORE_SUB_STAT_CD, T.KEY_ID, T.KEY_NAME, T.PRJ_ID, T.SYS_EMP_NO FROM TARGET_IDS T JOIN HCP_API_BASE API ON API.SVC_ID = T.SVC_ID JOIN HCP_API_PUB PUB ON API.API_ID = PUB.API_ID JOIN HCP_API_SUB SUB ON PUB.PUB_ID = SUB.PUB_ID AND SUB.KEY_ID = T.KEY_ID WHERE PUB.PUB_STAT_CD = 'NOR'
